title: A highly active and stable IrOx/SrIrO3 catalyst for the oxygen evolution reaction
conclusion: IrOₓ/SrIrO₃ 通过晶格氧氧化机制与应变调控，实现酸性 OER 活性与稳定性的协同提升，是铱基催化的标杆体系。

title: A unique oxygen ligand environment facilitates water oxidation in hole-doped IrNiOx core–shell electrocatalysts
conclusion: 空穴掺杂调控 Ir–O 配位环境，激活非常规氧配体参与 OER，降低过电位。

title: Engineering the electronic structure of single atom Ru sites via compressive strain boosts acidic water oxidation electrocatalysis
conclusion: 压缩应变调控 Ru 单原子 d 带中心，实现超低 Ru 载量下的高活性酸性 OER。

title: A Perovskite Oxide Optimized for Oxygen Evolution Catalysis from Molecular Orbital Principles
conclusion: 以 e_g 轨道占据数作为描述符，确立钙钛矿氧化物 OER 活性的分子轨道设计原则（火山型关系）。

title: Double perovskites as a family of highly active catalysts for oxygen evolution in alkaline solution
conclusion: 系统研究双钙钛矿家族，建立 O–2p 带中心与活性的关联，扩展碱性 OER 材料空间。

title: Breaking Long-Range Order in Iridium Oxide by Alkali Ion for Efficient Water Oxidation
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
conclusion: 碱金属插层打破 IrOₓ 长程有序，暴露更多活性位点并优化电子结构。

title: High-Performance Pyrochlore-Type Yttrium Ruthenate Electrocatalyst for Oxygen Evolution Reaction in Acidic Media
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
conclusion: 烧绿石结构 Y₂Ru₂O₇ 兼具高活性与优异酸性稳定性，是钌基抗溶解的代表路线。

title: Charge-Redistribution-Enhanced Nanocrystalline Ru@IrOx Electrocatalysts for Oxygen Evolution in Acidic Media
conclusion: 核壳电荷再分布增强 Ru 核的抗氧化性，兼顾 Ru 高活性与 IrOₓ 稳定性。

title: Electrocatalytic Oxygen Evolution Reaction (OER) on Ru, Ir, and Pt Catalysts: A Comparative Study of Nanoparticles and Bulk Materials
material_system: Ru / Ir / Pt 纳米颗粒
conclusion: 系统比较 Ru/Ir/Pt 的 OER 活性与稳定性，建立贵金属酸性 OER 的基准数据集。

title: Synthesis and Activities of Rutile IrO2 and RuO2 Nanoparticles for Oxygen Evolution in Acid and Alkaline Solutions
journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
conclusion: 定量对比金红石 IrO₂ 与 RuO₂ 在酸/碱中的本征活性，RuO₂ 活性更高但稳定性差。

title: Activity–Stability Trends for the Oxygen Evolution Reaction on Monometallic Oxides in Acidic Media
journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
material_system: IrO₂ / RuO₂ 等单金属氧化物
conclusion: 提出活性-稳定性权衡关系：活性越高溶解越剧烈，是酸性 OER 的核心矛盾。

title: Orientation-Dependent Oxygen Evolution Activities of Rutile IrO2 and RuO2
journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
conclusion: 单晶实验揭示金红石 IrO₂/RuO₂ 不同晶面的 OER 活性取向依赖，指导晶面工程。

title: Activating lattice oxygen redox reactions in metal oxides to catalyse oxygen evolution
material_system: 金属氧化物 (钙钛矿/尖晶石)
conclusion: 揭示晶格氧氧化 (LOM) 机制，突破传统吸附演化机制 (AEM) 的活性上限。

title: Chemical and structural origin of lattice oxygen oxidation in Co–Zn oxyhydroxide oxygen evolution electrocatalysts
conclusion: 原位表征+计算阐明晶格氧氧化的化学与结构起源，为 OER 机理设计提供范式。

title: Reversible amorphization and the catalytically active state of crystalline Co3O4 during oxygen evolution
conclusion: 发现 Co₃O₄ 在 OER 中发生可逆非晶化，真正的活性相为表面非晶层。

title: Iridium-based double perovskites for efficient water oxidation in acid media
conclusion: 铱基双钙钛矿在酸性介质中高效产氧，为减少贵金属铱用量提供结构平台。

title: Na-doped ruthenium perovskite electrocatalysts with improved oxygen evolution activity and durability in acidic media
conclusion: Na 掺杂稳定钌钙钛矿晶格，显著提升酸性 OER 活性与耐久性。

title: Determining Potentials of Zero Charge of Metal Electrodes from First-Principles Calculations
authors: Le J., Iannuzzi M., Cuesta A., Cheng J.
journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
cp2k_settings: PBE + GTH 赝势 + DZVP-MOLOPT-SR-GTH；金属电极 + 隐式溶剂 SCCS；AIMD 采样电极/水双电层
conclusion: 用 CP2K 从头算方法确定金属电极零电荷电位，为电催化界面建模提供基准（整理示例条目，请核验原文）。
